title: ResearchRunResult
description: The immutable record of one research run: which universe it consumed, which underlyings were researched, how each one ended, and which model answered. One report per underlying, never a single merged answer for several - a shared context lets one asset's story colour another's, and the resulting outlook could not be attributed to either. Appended, never overwritten: a later run produces a new record so 'what did the system believe on date T' stays answerable after the configuration, the data and the model have all moved on.

status.description: The run's own outcome, distinct from any one symbol's. A run succeeds when it produced at least one outlook; each symbol's own status is always preserved on its own report.

universe_run_id.description: The universe this run consumed. Research never selects its own subjects.

reports.description: One MarketResearchReport per underlying. Validated in full against market_research_report.json; referenced loosely here so the two files stay independently maintainable.

counts.description: How many underlyings reached each outcome. Elapsed time is deliberately absent: a measured duration is a fact about the machine, not the decision, and storing it inside a content-addressed record would make two otherwise identical runs differ.
